chapter.heading: The Futility of Idols and the Trustworthiness of God
chapter.v:
Not unto
us, O Lord, not unto us,But to Your name give glory,Because of Your mercy,Because of Your truth. [Josh. 21:18; 1 Kin. 2:26; 1 Chr. 6:60; Is. 10:30; Jer.]

Why should
the Gentiles say,“So where is their God?” [Jer. 25:3] [1 Kin. 13:2; 2 Kin. 21:24; 2 Chr. 34:1; Jer. 3:6; 36:2]

But our
God is in heaven;He does whatever He pleases.

Their idols
are silver and gold,The work of men’s hands.

They have
hands, but they do not handle;Feet they have, but they do not walk;Nor do they mutter through their throat. [Num. 22:20, 38; Jer. 1:17; Matt.]

Those who
make them are like them;So is everyone who trusts in them. [Ezek. 2:6; 3:9] [Ex. 3:12; Deut. 31:6; Josh. 1:5; Jer. 15:20; Heb. 13:6]

O Israel,
trust in the Lord;He is their help and their shield. [Is. 6:7; Mark] [Ex. 4:11-16; Deut. 18:18; Is.]

O house
of Aaron, trust in the Lord;He is their help and their shield. [Jer. 18:7-10; Ezek. 22:18; [2 Cor.] [1 Kin. 19:17]

You who
fear the Lord, trust in the Lord;He is their help and their shield.

The Lord
has been mindful of us;He will bless us;He will bless the house of Israel;He will bless the house of Aaron.

He will
bless those who fear the Lord,Both small and great. [Ezek. 11:3;]

May the
Lord give you increase more and more,You and your children. [Jer. 6:1]

May you
be blessed by the Lord,Who made heaven and earth. [Is. 22:7; Jer.]

The heaven,
even the heavens, are the Lord’s;But the earth He has given to the children of men. [Deut. 28:20; Jer. 17:13 x Is. 65:3, 4; Jer. 7:9 y Is. 37:19; Jer. 2:28]

The dead
do not praise the Lord,Nor any who go down into silence. [Ezek. 2:6] [1 Kin. 18:46; 2 Kin. 4:29; Job 38:3; Luke 12:35; [1 Pet. 1:13]]

But we
will bless the LordFrom this time forth and forevermore.Praise the Lord! [Is. 50:7; Jer.]
